name: jianying-edit
description: Native, fully editable JianYing Pro drafts from jy14-headless plans or compiled edit-plans, driven through the user's jianying-headless fork unmodified: multi-track video/text/audio with transitions, keyframes, masks, narration condensing, and native MP4 export. Pinned to macOS JianYing 11.4.x.

description_i18n.en: Native JianYing Pro drafts from jy14-headless plans or compiled edit-plans via the unmodified jianying-headless fork: multi-track video/text/audio, transitions/keyframes/masks, narration condensing, native export.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过未改动的 jianying-headless fork，把 jy14 计划或编译后的口播计划一键发布为剪映原生草稿：多轨视频/文字/音频、转场/关键帧/蒙版、口播精剪与原生导出。
